facts.text: Deborah finds doing yoga on the beach to be a relaxing experience.

evidence.quote: Doing this on the beach is so peaceful - the ocean, sand, and fresh air create a super relaxing atmosphere.
It's amazing how our environment can enhance our practice.

facts.text: Jolene creates a serene yoga space using candles, oils, and soft music.

evidence.quote: I like to create my own serene yoga space with candles and oils for extra chill vibes.
I use essential oils and put on some soft, soothing music in the background to create a peaceful atmosphere.

facts.text: Jolene mentions trying a new style of meditation in Thailand that involved flowers.

evidence.quote: we tried a new style of meditation in Thailand - with flowers.
